model.preprocessing: BERT paired query/document encoding, max 512 tokens, longest-first truncation, single example without padding; raw classification logit, no sigmoid or pooling.
model.provenance: Official upstream float32 ONNX, pinned commit and LFS hash.

scope: Evaluation only, no new production model, dependencies, defaults, downloads or release assets.
pool: First 32 eligible distinct primary-index records in actual MiniLM cosine/UUID order. No gold insertion or query-specific aliases. Export full stored title/newline/content as each document. All records, including negative placeholders, retain existing fixture semantics.
admission: Only queries with zero MiniLM returned records and no query files. Rank eligible pool by pairwise cross-encoder logit, UUID tie break. Require a runner-up. Gate top winner by raw logit and top-minus-second logit margin; append at most one source record in unused slots with native packet guard. Do not promote another candidate if the winner is already present or fails.
selection: Original/fresh/new development only. Evaluate all 45 policies using actual native packet previews and unchanged per-record comparator. Pick maximum safe complete-answer gains, ties higher logit then higher margin. Any potential improvement must pass historical development then heldout before production consideration. No changed negative packet identities, prior delivered fact/rank loss, scope/trust/filter/fallback/budget failure. No change to a previously answered positive (empty-baseline admission enforces this).
compatibility: First compare both official README Berlin query/document logits [8.607138,-4.320078] within 0.01; no fixture scoring if that fails.
fallback: If no safe gain, reject family and retain results. No heldout scoring after development rejection.
